usageGuidelines: Use this when the user wants a human-readable Morning Brief.
Use raw deltasignal_morning_brief when the caller wants structured JSON only.
Evidence drilldowns and article/social drafts must be requested after evidence is returned, not generated by this route automatically.

annotations.title: DeltaSignal Morning Brief Natural Language brief

description: Use this premium read-only Natural Language tool when the user wants the server-composed Morning Brief rendered as audit-grade Markdown. It compiles backend-composed compact evidence across readiness, daily changes, risk distribution, top stressed issuers, and alpha opportunities. The renderer never fans out into tools and never generates social drafts or trade recommendations. Parameters: style is professional, concise, trader, or detailed. Date and limit are accepted only where the backend composite supports them. Behavior: read-only and idempotent; it performs the server-enforced Morning Brief workflow, has no destructive side effects, then renders the returned compact evidence as a bounded Natural Language response.

limit.description: Optional compact record limit where supported.

period.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date selector when supported by the backend composite.

style.description: Rendering style. Style changes tone and density only, not facts.

name: deltasignal_morning_brief_natural

outputSchema.description: DeltaSignal ATLAS-7 MCPResponse wrapper. Raw tool payload is returned under data.

data.description: Natural Language Morning Brief response rendered from backend-composed compact evidence.

alpha_opportunities.description: Raw deltasignal_alpha_opportunities payload from the fixed limit=10 call when it succeeds.

alpha_opportunities_audit.description: Raw deltasignal_alpha_opportunities_audit payload from the fixed limit=10 call when it succeeds. This leg is advisory and explains board filters, quality gates, and rank demotions.

bundle.description: Execution state for the composite workflow, including status, partial, timing, payload_mode, and concurrency.

combined_provenance.description: Source dates, computed dates, compacted state, and aggregate timing across successful internal calls.

daily_changes.description: Compacted raw deltasignal_daily_changes payload when that internal call succeeds.

errors.description: Failed internal subtool records. Successful calls are never replaced with synthesized data.

internal_calls.description: Internal subtool call ledger with exact tool names, arguments, routes, statuses, and elapsed milliseconds.

issuer_drilldown_policy.description: Morning-brief issuer drilldown policy. Standard morning briefs do not run advisory issuer layers automatically; use company-report or deep-brief follow-ups for fundamentals, stress, peer, alpha, and SPECTRA evidence.

issuer_drilldowns.description: Reserved issuer evidence groups. Empty for standard morning briefs unless a future explicit deep-brief mode runs issuer drilldowns.

mcp_billing_estimate.description: Single-call bundle billing estimate and public x402-equivalent internal call ledger.

partial.description: True when at least one internal subtool failed.

partial_failure_policy.description: Human-readable policy for preserving successful sections and verbatim failed subtool errors.

readiness.description: Raw deltasignal_readiness payload when that internal call succeeds.

request.description: Normalized composite input such as tool, output_mode, ticker, and period.

risk_distribution.description: Raw deltasignal_risk_distribution payload when that internal call succeeds.

spectra_field_map.description: Raw deltasignal_spectra_field_map payload when a company-report SPECTRA advisory leg succeeds.

top_stressed.description: Raw deltasignal_top_stressed payload from the fixed limit=10 call when it succeeds.

workflow.description: Composite MCP workflow name, normally deltasignal_morning_brief.

mcp_summary.description: Concise high-signal summary of the tool response. Maximum 140 characters.

provenance.description: Traceability information for the MCP tool response.

compacted.description: Whether the data payload was compacted for MCP context safety.

elapsed_ms.description: Elapsed time for the MCP tool call in milliseconds.

freshness_window_hours.description: Freshness window in hours when reported by the underlying tool.

latest_activity_source_date.description: Latest CompanyFacts activity source date when available.

latest_computed_source_date.description: Latest computed DeltaSignal source date when available.

source_date.description: Primary DeltaSignal source date when available.

suggested_follow_ups.description: Concrete next MCP calls an agent can run to continue the workflow.

args.description: Arguments for the suggested MCP tool call.

tool.description: MCP tool name to call next.

usage_metadata.description: Performance and estimated cost metadata for this MCP tool call.

elapsed_ms.description: Elapsed time for the MCP tool call in milliseconds.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated public x402-equivalent cost in USD when known.
